name: net_match_ends_with_agreed_result
description: Two idle clients lose the hollow: each sends RESULT with the same final tick, hash and outcome, the sequencer agrees and ends the match, and both stop on that tick with MATCH_END lost.

steps.msg: the sequencer ended the match on the agreed result

steps.assert: scene.tick(1) == scene.tick(2) and scene.tick(1) == scene.client(1).final_tick and scene.seq.final_tick == scene.tick(1)
steps.msg: both stopped on the final tick the server announced
each sent its RESULT, and every hash agreed
